name: ptyper3-bisect-serial
description: Which step of the parallel typer spike between `b650049602` and `3c72e64ddf` costs the serial compiler (no flag): `ptyper2-serial-typer` measured `3c72e64ddf` about 6.7% slower than `2.13.x` on re2s through the typer, where `b650049602` was within the noise of `2.13.x`. Every build paired within each fork, re2s stopped after the typer; the A/A of `ptyper2-serial-typer` (within ±2%) is this campaign's noise floor too.

variantDescriptions.b650: the spike at `b650049602`: completion lock, per-thread phase and the parallel driver
variantDescriptions.ac63: the spike at `ac63a36bbd`: flags updated by compare-and-set when concurrent, loaders under the lock, scope entries published with a fence and the element cache keyed by the head
variantDescriptions.c7ae: the spike at `7ae25083a2`: lock-free type caches and local completions, scala-sharing's CoarseLock, ScratchThread, scala-sharing vendored into scala-reflect
variantDescriptions.spike: the spike at `3c72e64ddf`: the x-ray recorder hooks
